attorneys: Raymond Harkrider and Owen W. Crumpacker for appellant. /. Emmett McManamon, Attorney General of Indiana, and John J. McShane, Lloyd C. Hutchinson and Joseph E. Nowak, Deputy Attorneys General, for the Gross Income Tax Division, appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:
